definitions.explanation: A written record of experiences, observations, and impressions during a trip or journey.

examples.japanese: {旅日記|たびにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけている→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
{旅日記|たびにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}す→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: It's fun to read back through my travel diary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧{旅日記|たびにっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: We found a travel diary my grandmother wrote when she was young.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ (trip, journey) + ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧ (diary). Travel diaries have a long literary tradition in Japan, with classical works like ⟦{松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧'s ⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細道|ほそみち}→細道：23053_hosomichi⟧ being among the most famous examples of the genre.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅日記|たびにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to keep a travel diary
- {旅日記|たびにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a travel diary
- {旅日記|たびにっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to publish a travel diary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紀行|きこう}→紀行：13823_kikou⟧: travelogue — a more literary or formal account of a journey, often intended for publication, while {旅日記|たびにっき} is more personal
- ⟦{旅行記|りょこうき}→旅行記：22659_ryokouki⟧: travel account — similar to {旅日記|たびにっき} but often more structured and less diary-like in format
